core_findings.dependencies: Treasury permission includes accounting permission. Prototype couples these paid modules.
core_findings.limits: No live database access. Blockers are explained, not simulated. Acceptance has a WARN definition, but save_modules only applies module guards to newly disabled unflagged modules; acceptance uses a dedicated flag.
core_findings.commercial_proposal: 10,000 core + 36,000 optional modules + 4,000 advanced tools/mode = 50,000. UI preferences, mobile access, notifications, feedback and help have no surcharge.
